Eileen K: Hi folks, quick onboarding question. On M1 Air using fish. Followed the dotfiles, installed asdf, direnv, brew in /opt/homebrew. direnv rejects .envrc with 'layout asdf not found'. Any fish-specific ordering I missed?

Marco T: Welcome! For fish make sure you source asdf before direnv hook. In ~/.config/fish/config.fish do: `set -gx PATH /opt/homebrew/bin $PATH` then `source ~/.asdf/asdf.fish` then `eval (direnv hook fish)`.

Eileen K: That fixed it. One more: pyenv build failed complaining about openssl. I installed openssl@3 via brew. Should I export CPPFLAGS/LDFLAGS globally?

Lina S: Don't export globally. Put the flags in a temporary shell when installing Python: `env LDFLAGS="-L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/lib" CPPFLAGS="-I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/include" pyenv install 3.11.6`. Keep per-project envs in .envrc.

Eileen K: Great. Also, who handles adding me to the 1Password new-hires folder?

infra-bot: Created ticket OPS-2210 to onboard Eileen K to 1Password and add SSH keys.

Eileen K: Thanks everyone! Will open a PR after dotfiles sync if anything else pops up. :raised_hands:
